tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: The available documentation topics with one-line summaries. Call first, then get_doc.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: One documentation topic as markdown: the booking API contract, checkout, widgets, attribution, live chat, the customer portal, or the per-account booking MCP server.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Keyword search across all documentation topics. Returns matching sections with excerpts; follow up with get_doc for the full topic.

tools.name: get_integration_brief
tools.description: A self-contained brief for a coding agent building a transfer-booking website on the RideDesk API — the flow, the rules the server enforces, and the acceptance criteria.

tools.name: get_widget_snippets
tools.description: Copy-paste tags: the attribution script, the live-chat script, and the embeddable booking/enquiry/rental widget iframes.
